title: Most businesses aren't getting engineering.
subtitle: The Egyptian and Arab web market is saturated with agencies that charge custom rates for commodity output. Read each line across: on one side is what was promised, on the other is what was delivered.

items.pitch: “A custom website, designed around your brand.”
items.delivery: A $60 theme with the logo swapped in.
items.evidence: Indistinguishable from competitors running the same theme

items.delivery: Seven seconds to first paint in production.
A login and a zip file. No docs, no architecture, no history.
items.evidence: You own the domain. They own the knowledge.

items.delivery: Built to survive the approval meeting.
items.evidence: Every new feature costs more than the last

items.pitch: “A dedicated technical lead on your account.”
items.delivery: A coordinator relaying messages to an offshore team.
items.evidence: Two weeks added to every timeline, no answer to any technical question
